findings.evidence: The generated comparison drill marked 보다 더 false in ‘이 바지가 저 바지___ 짧아요,’ although both 저 바지보다 짧아요 and 저 바지보다 더 짧아요 are grammatical and equivalent for the task.
findings.fix: Added a failing regression and changed the compiler to omit cloze drills when one offered variant is an optional longer form of another; the invalid drill is absent after recompilation.

findings.evidence: The lesson labeled appearance -아/어 보이다 as A/V even though its rows and examples teach descriptive adjectives; ordinary action verbs require a different construction for this meaning.
findings.fix: Renamed the local pattern and lesson hint to A-아/어 보이다 and recompiled.

findings.evidence: The boss prompt asked which sentence is polite while both 보여 주세요 and 보여 주시겠어요? are polite requests.
findings.fix: Changed the prompt to ask for the most deferential request and explicitly explained that both forms are polite.

notes: All 11 bites and the resulting 38 cards were reviewed after the ambiguous generated drill was removed; no unfixed blocker remains.
